feature_under_test: monotonic Backfill aggregate advancement on the successful result path

implementation.before: every successful item result scanned every item in its Backfill with four SUM predicates while holding the parent row lock
implementation.after: the transaction advances succeeded_items by one from the already locked Backfill state; failure, accepted-gap, cancellation, and repair paths retain factual reconciliation
implementation.complexity_change: successful completion aggregation changes from O(n^2) total item visits per Backfill to O(n)
implementation.serialization_fence: loadBackfillOfferFence selects the parent Backfill and queued item FOR UPDATE before the item transition
implementation.replay_fence: the durable command receipt is checked before item and aggregate mutation

mysql_contract_assertions: two distinct queued items each advance the aggregate once
replaying each accepted result does not advance the aggregate again
the completed parent aggregate equals factual item-status counts
parent Work completes and the current Job remains unchanged

capacity_assessment.interpretation: the change removes data-size-dependent aggregate work and is retained for asymptotic safety, but the measured single-host throughput gain is small and does not close the production capacity gate

known_repository_gate.make_lint_status: fails on a pre-existing web/societyconsole to drivers/tools/society/model dependency that is unchanged from a94d2b8d
known_repository_gate.remediation_in_this_branch: the Recruiting Extension Bridge Go package was moved from the unregistered top-level tools directory into drivers/tools/recruiting/extensionbridge without changing the Atoll layer allowlist

non_claims: daily Detail result-path acceleration because the measured workload is live-refetch Backfill

acceptance.reason: the O(n^2) aggregate scan is removed, but optimized H3 remains 23.29 percent below the arithmetic 8-hour reference
